propositions: test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds fails with StoreError 'unable to write new index file' on macOS py3.13 CI runs under load

test plants a young index.lock and uses threading.Timer to delete it, but timer fire time (t=0.4) coincides with git commit holding its own real index.lock on slow runners, causing timer to delete git's lock mid-commit
test's timer-based lock release lacks identity checking and cannot distinguish planted lock from git's own lock, creating race window on slow machines
replacing wall-clock threading.Timer with gitutil._retry_probe deterministic mechanism fires after each retry attempt and prevents deletion of locks held by git
production code path in _git_add and _git_commit with force_reclaim=True is correct; failure is test-local and unrelated to store backoff logic or runner resource exhaustion
